```{r packages}
if (!require("dplyr")) {install.packages("dplyr"); require("dplyr")}

if (!require("tidyverse")) {install.packages("tidyverse"); require("tidyverse")} 
```

```{r data}
# Import data 

# CSVs
CS_dat <- read.csv("Raw_data/ClinicalScreener Baseline.csv")
Pioneer_dat <- read.csv("Raw_data/Pioneer Baseline.csv")
R15_dat <- read.csv("Raw_data/R15 baseline.csv")

# SAVs
ORP_dat <- read_sav("Raw_data/ORP_FULL_CLEAN.sav")
PT_dat <- read_sav("Raw_data/PTvCBT_FULL_CLEAN.sav")

# CS: rm_1 through rm_72 
# R15: rm_1 through rm_72
# Pioneer: t1rm_1 --> tqrm_72
# ORP: f4_rm_1 through f4_rm_72 OR f3, or just rm...
# PT: rm_1 though rm_72 or t1.3 etc
```
